faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about installments, applications, payments and delivery

seo.description: BRB FAQ: installment terms, applying, payment methods, delivery and returns.

empty.title: No questions found
empty.description: Try another word or send us your question.

contact.title: Did not find an answer?
contact.description: Send us your question and our specialists will reply.

documents.question: What documents do I need for an installment plan?
documents.answer: An identity document, a phone number and a completed application are enough. Additional documents may be requested in some cases.

limits.question: What are the minimum and maximum amounts?
limits.answer: The limits depend on the product and the outcome of your application. The values in the calculator are examples.

accuracy.question: Are the calculator results exact?
accuracy.answer: The calculator shows a preliminary estimate. Final terms are set after your application is reviewed.

early.question: Can I repay early?
early.answer: Early repayment terms are stated in the contract. Contact us for exact information.

returns.question: What is the return policy?
returns.answer: Return terms depend on the product type and the seller. Details are given on the product page.

howToApply.question: How do I apply for an installment plan?
howToApply.answer: Choose a product, press “Buy in installments” and fill in the online application. It has a few steps: product, personal details, documents and confirmation.

decisionTime.question: How long does the review take?
decisionTime.answer: The review time depends on how complete the application and documents are. You are notified of the result by SMS and in your account.

status.question: Where can I see the application status?
status.answer: The “Applications” section of your account shows the status of every application and document.

cancel.question: Can I cancel an application?
cancel.answer: An application can be cancelled until the contract is signed. Contact the help section of your account or the contact centre.

methods.question: How do I make the monthly payment?
methods.answer: Payment methods are listed in the contract. Usually you can pay by bank card, through payment apps or at a branch cash desk.

schedule.question: Where do I find the payment schedule?
schedule.answer: The payment schedule is issued with the contract and is available in the “Contracts” section of your account.

late.question: What happens if I pay late?
late.answer: The consequences of a late payment are set by the contract. If you cannot pay on time, contact us in advance and we will look for a solution together.

shipping.question: How is the product delivered?
shipping.answer: The delivery method and time depend on the product and the region. The exact details are shown on the product page and at checkout.

warranty.question: Is the product covered by a warranty?
warranty.answer: The warranty period is set by the manufacturer and the seller and is shown on the product page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How BRB collects, uses and protects the personal data of its users.

general.title: General provisions
general.body: This policy sets out how personal data is processed when you use the BRB website and services. By using the website you agree to these terms.

data.title: What data is collected
data.body: When you register and apply, we collect your name, phone number, email, identity document details, and information about your orders and payments.

purposes.title: Why the data is used
purposes.body: The data is used to review your application, conclude and perform the contract, deliver your order, contact you and improve the quality of the service.

storage.title: Storage and protection
storage.body: The data is stored on protected servers and only authorized staff can access it. The storage period is defined by the law and by the contract.

sharing.title: Sharing with third parties
sharing.body: The data is shared only when it is needed to provide the service — for example, with a delivery service or a payment organization — and in the cases provided for by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may review your data, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, and withdraw your consent to its processing.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The website uses cookies and browser storage to remember the selected language, the cart and your favorites. You can turn them off in the browser settings.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: The rules for using the BRB website and services.

general.title: General provisions
general.body: These terms govern the relationship between BRB and the user of the website. By starting to use the website you accept the terms.

account.title: Registration and account
account.body: When you create an account you must provide accurate and current details. You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details confidential.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: Product descriptions, prices and availability on the website are given for information and may change. An order is placed only once it is confirmed.

installment.title: Installment terms
installment.body: The figures in the calculator and on the product page are preliminary. The final rate, term and payment schedule are set in the contract after the application is reviewed.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments are made according to the schedule in the contract. If a payment is late, the measures provided for by the contract apply.

delivery.title: Delivery and returns
delivery.body: The delivery time and method are shown at checkout. Returns are handled in line with the applicable law and the seller’s terms.

liability.title: Liability and changes
liability.body: BRB is not liable for the service being temporarily unavailable because of technical failures. These terms may be updated; a new version takes effect when it is published on the website.
